    - heading "Understand Cosine Graph" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "The cosine graph plots y=cos x against angle x. In Cosine Graph, that statement is the exact rule used on the labelled chart and in the three numerical examples. A useful rule is Cosine parent graph: y=cos x. You can learn Cosine Graph by trying one small example instead of long theory."
    - paragraph: Track the x-coordinate on the unit circle as the angle changes. Plot angle against cosine value. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
